name: Osananajimi Yori mo Eroi Mobko to no Houkago Ecchi ~Boku wa Class no Jimiko ni Koi o Shita~
original_name: 幼馴染みよりもエロいモブ子との放課後エッチ ～ボクはクラスの地味子に恋をした～
source:
Hiroto Yamagami is a very ordinary and normal student. His childhood friend is a beautiful and popular girl named Aoi Hinasaki.

Aoi has a crush on Hiroto, but he is unaware of it and continues this one-sided love affair with her.

One day, Hiroto sees a girl masturbating in an empty classroom. She is so plain that he doesn't even know her name, but she is Ayumi Sonoda. 

She climaxed while stifling her voice and looked up at the ceiling with an ecstatic expression. Seeing her like that, Hiroto felt his first emotion. It was his first love...

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_226.html#story]official site[/url]]
translation:
山上浩人是一个非常普通、正常的学生。他的青梅竹马是一位美丽而受欢迎的女孩，名叫雏崎葵。

葵暗恋着广人，但他却浑然不觉，并继续与她展开单方面的恋情。

有一天，弘人看到一名女孩在一间空荡荡的教室里自慰。她相貌平平，连她的名字都不知道，但她就是园田步美。

她压住声音达到了高潮，一脸欣喜若狂地抬头看着天花板。看到她这个样子，弘人感受到了他的第一感觉。这是他的初恋……
